title: The card ship's git fetch has no timeout and can hold the project's queue indefinitely
notes:
**[low]** [out-of-scope] The card ship's own fetch in `src/main/ship/ship-flow.ts:52` (`await git(['fetch', base.remote, base.branch], projectPath)`) still has no timeout. It runs with the project's queue held, as this one does.

What happens: a ship starts while the connection to the remote stalls mid-transfer. ssh without `ServerAliveInterval` can wait indefinitely. The queue stays held, and the next `pane run --worktree` in that project waits behind it with no answer, so the 60-second cap added here never gets to run. The PR keeps the ship's refusal on purpose, and that is right. Whether the ship gets the same timeout is a separate question from whether it may start from a stale base. Predates this change, so it goes in the follow-up.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/381
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/378#discussion_r4705693672
